notes.en: Cross-compiled zai CLI and browser GUI packages built from one pinned source revision.
notes.zh-CN: 由同一份固定源代码修订版交叉编译出的 zai CLI 和浏览器界面安装包。

notes.en: Release archives are published publicly while the application source stays private.
notes.zh-CN: 应用源代码保持私有，仅公开发布安装包。

notes.en: Every archive is unsigned; verify the SHA-256 shown on the download page.
notes.zh-CN: 所有压缩包均未签名；请核对下载页显示的 SHA-256 校验值。

installNotes.en: Unsigned build. Install with the one-line installer, which verifies this archive's SHA-256. To install manually, extract the whole archive and run 'python3 install.py' ('python install.py' on Windows) from the extracted folder. Python 3.10 or newer is required to install; install your coding-agent CLI separately before using it with zai. The browser GUI is included; use a modern browser and run zai gui stop before external updates.
installNotes.zh-CN: 未签名的构建。建议使用一行安装命令，它会校验该压缩包的 SHA-256。如需手动安装，请完整解压后在解压目录运行 “python3 install.py”（Windows 上为 “python install.py”）。安装需要 Python 3.10 及以上；请另行安装所需的编程代理 CLI。内含浏览器界面；需要现代浏览器，外部更新前请运行 zai gui stop。
